changelog: I10 source-drift detection compares current legacy state with accepted shadow SourceHash.
Signed cutover preflight requires manual QA, correct sequence, valid acceptance and WordPress identity/permalink.
HMAC token is bound to the exact immutable preflight snapshot and expires automatically.
Executable=false and PublicMutationAvailable=false; preflight grants no activation capability.
No activate/cutover/publish handler is added; Vehicle/Event/Gallery remain protected on legacy runtime.
